caption: The drawing consists of several rectangular sections, each containing simplistic, abstract shapes reminiscent of petroglyphs or cave paintings, rendered primarily in shades of red, black, and orange on a beige background. In the upper left section, there is a figure with an outstretched, angular body and arms, accompanied by zigzag and sun-like forms. Next to it is a vertical, segmented pattern, followed by a circular, turtle-like shape with a dark center and blue accents. The top right contains a row of curved lines with small vertical marks above them, and adjacent to this are two circular motifs: one with an inner oval and one with a ring of small dots. Below, there are figures with simplified, stick-like bodies and limbs, and one small humanoid shape with outspread arms and legs. The bottom left section features a crowned, rectangular object with a dark center, followed by a plain, vertical red oval with small projections at the base. In the center, humanoid figures with outstretched limbs appear, some showing exaggerated hands or feet. The bottom right section contains a large, irregular red shape with a yellow oval on top, surrounded by a white dotted outline, set against a dark, speckled background. The composition uses geometric divisions to separate the various objects and figures, with red and black coloration dominant against a lighter, neutral background.
title: Petroglyph - Human Figures
